const (
	WorkerActive     WorkerLifecycle = "active"
	WorkerHibernated WorkerLifecycle = "hibernated"
	WorkerArchived   WorkerLifecycle = "archived"
)

const Running engine.Outcome = "running"

const TaskQueued engine.Outcome = "queued"

func (ConnectionSecrets) GoString() string

func (ConnectionSecrets) String() string

func (ConnectionUpdate) GoString() string

func (ConnectionUpdate) String() string

func (b BrowserSettings) Validate() error

func (c CommandSettings) Validate() error

func (c ModelConnection) Apply(u ConnectionUpdate, secret ConnectionSecrets) (ModelConnection, ConnectionSecrets, error)

func (c ModelConnection) Clone() ModelConnection

func (c ModelConnection) ModelEndpoint(modelID string) string

func (c ModelConnection) Target(model ConnectionModel) Target

func (c ModelConnection) Validate() error

func (d AutomationDraft) Validate() error

func (d MediaDecoder) Validate() error

func (p Preferences) Apply(update PreferenceUpdate) (Preferences, error)

func (p Preferences) Validate() error

func (r *Runtime) ActiveExecution(sessionID string) (executionID string, active bool)

func (r *Runtime) Cancel(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error

func (r *Runtime) CancelExecution(ctx context.Context, sessionID, expectedExecutionID string) error

func (r *Runtime) Close(ctx context.Context) error

func (r *Runtime) Descriptor(id string) (engine.Descriptor, bool)

func (r *Runtime) EngineDescriptions() []engine.Description

func (r *Runtime) HasActive() bool

func (r *Runtime) Register(id string, runtime engine.Runtime) error

func (r *Runtime) RegisterDescriptor(id string, descriptor engine.Descriptor) error

func (r *Runtime) RespondPermission(ctx context.Context, sessionID, requestID string, decision engine.PermissionDecision) error

func (r *Runtime) ResumeWait(ctx context.Context, id, branch, turn string, revision uint64) (string, <-chan error, error)

func (r *Runtime) Run(owner context.Context, sessionID, prompt string) error

func (r *Runtime) SessionActive(id string) bool

func (r *Runtime) Start(owner context.Context, sessionID, prompt string) (string, <-chan error, error)

func (r *Runtime) StartAutomation(owner, admission context.Context, tick AutomationTick, at int64) (string, <-chan error, error)

func (r *Runtime) StartOnBranch(owner context.Context, sessionID, branchID, prompt string) (string, <-chan error, error)

func (r *Runtime) StartWorkerTask(owner context.Context, lead, team, workerID string) (WorkerTask, <-chan error, error)

func (r *Runtime) WithExclusiveWorkspaces(ctx context.Context, paths []string, apply func(context.Context) error) error

func (s Settings) Validate() error

func (s ToolSettings) Validate() error

func (t Target) Validate() error

func BlocksInput(status engine.Outcome) bool

func ClaimsConflict(a, b []ResourceClaim) bool

func DefaultPreferences() Preferences

func EncodeHandoff(h *Handoff) (string, error)

func New(store ExecutionStore) *Runtime

func NewID(prefix string) (string, error)

func NewWithWaits(store interface {
	ExecutionStore
	WaitStore
}) *Runtime

func PreferenceChoices() PreferenceOptions

func RouteKey(target Target) string

func ValidateAEP(entries []AEPBundle) error

func ValidateTask(scope string, claims []ResourceClaim) error

type AEPBundle struct {
	ID                 string            `json:"id"`
	SourceDirectory    string            `json:"source_directory"`
	Interpreter        string            `json:"interpreter"`
	InterpreterArgs    []string          `json:"interpreter_args,omitempty"`
	Env                map[string]string `json:"env,omitempty"`
	Name               string            `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Version            string            `json:"version,omitempty"`
	SHA256             string            `json:"sha256,omitempty"`
	Enabled            bool              `json:"enabled"`
	HostAccessApproved bool              `json:"host_access_approved"`
}

type Attempt struct {
	Wait                *engine.WaitCheckpoint `json:"wait,omitempty"`
	ID                  string                 `json:"id"`
	TurnID              string                 `json:"turn_id"`
	SessionID           string                 `json:"session_id"`
	BranchID            string                 `json:"branch_id"`
	Target              Target                 `json:"target"`
	NativeSessionID     string                 `json:"native_session_id"`
	Status              engine.Outcome         `json:"status"`
	SideEffectsPossible bool                   `json:"side_effects_possible"`
	Failure             engine.FailureKind     `json:"failure"`
	Error               string                 `json:"error"`
	CreatedAt           int64                  `json:"created_at"`
	EndedAt             int64                  `json:"ended_at"`
}

type Automation struct {
	ID        string `json:"id"`
	SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
	AutomationDraft
	Enabled       bool   `json:"enabled"`
	Revision      uint64 `json:"revision"`
	BranchID      string `json:"branch_id"`
	Target        Target `json:"target"`
	NextRunAt     int64  `json:"next_run_at,omitempty"`
	LastRunAt     int64  `json:"last_run_at,omitempty"`
	LastStatus    string `json:"last_status"`
	LastError     string `json:"last_error,omitempty"`
	RunningTurnID string `json:"running_turn_id,omitempty"`
}

type AutomationDraft struct {
	Title           string `json:"title"`
	Prompt          string `json:"prompt"`
	IntervalMinutes int64  `json:"interval_minutes"`
}

type AutomationStore interface {
	ListAutomations(context.Context, string) ([]Automation, error)
	Automation(context.Context, string, string) (Automation, error)
	CreateAutomation(context.Context, string, AutomationDraft) (Automation, error)
	UpdateAutomation(context.Context, string, string, uint64, AutomationDraft) (Automation, error)
	SetAutomationEnabled(context.Context, string, string, uint64, bool, bool) (Automation, error)
	DeleteAutomation(context.Context, string, string, uint64) error
	DueAutomations(context.Context, int64) ([]AutomationTick, error)
	ClaimAutomation(context.Context, AutomationTick, int64) (Claim, error)
	SkipBusyAutomation(context.Context, AutomationTick, int64) error
	PauseInvalidAutomation(context.Context, AutomationTick) error
}

type AutomationTick struct {
	ID        string `json:"id"`
	SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
	Revision  uint64 `json:"revision"`
}

type Branch struct {
	ID              string `json:"id"`
	SessionID       string `json:"session_id"`
	Target          Target `json:"target"`
	NativeSessionID string `json:"native_session_id"`
	Watermark       uint64 `json:"watermark"`
	Parked          bool   `json:"parked"`
}

type BrowserSettings struct {
	Executable         string            `json:"executable"`
	Env                map[string]string `json:"env,omitempty"`
	Headless           bool              `json:"headless"`
	Proxy              string            `json:"proxy,omitempty"`
	StartupTimeoutMS   int               `json:"startup_timeout_ms,omitempty"`
	OperationTimeoutMS int               `json:"operation_timeout_ms,omitempty"`
	Enabled            bool              `json:"enabled"`
	HostAccessApproved bool              `json:"host_access_approved"`
}

type Claim struct {
	Session      Session
	Branch       Branch
	Turn         Turn
	Attempt      Attempt
	Handoff      *Handoff
	WaitRevision uint64
}

type CommandSettings struct {
	Hooks       []HookSpec       `json:"hooks"`
	Diagnostics []DiagnosticSpec `json:"diagnostics"`
}

type ConnectionModel struct {
	ID      string `json:"id"`
	Name    string `json:"name"`
	Enabled bool   `json:"enabled"`

	ImageCapable bool `json:"image_capable"`
}

type ConnectionSecrets struct {
	APIKey  string            `json:"-"`
	Headers map[string]string `json:"-"`
}

type ConnectionUpdate struct {
	ID               string            `json:"id"`
	ExpectedRevision uint64            `json:"expected_revision"`
	Name             string            `json:"name"`
	Protocol         string            `json:"protocol"`
	Endpoint         string            `json:"endpoint"`
	Auth             string            `json:"auth"`
	Enabled          bool              `json:"enabled"`
	Models           []ConnectionModel `json:"models"`

	APIKey         string            `json:"-"`
	ClearAPIKey    bool              `json:"clear_api_key"`
	Headers        map[string]string `json:"-"`
	ReplaceHeaders bool              `json:"replace_headers"`
}

type ConnectionsStore interface {
	Connections(context.Context) ([]ModelConnection, error)
	SaveConnection(context.Context, ConnectionUpdate) (ModelConnection, error)
	DeleteConnection(context.Context, string, uint64) error
	ConnectionSecrets(context.Context, string, uint64) (ConnectionSecrets, error)
}

type Detail struct {
	Session  Session  `json:"session"`
	Branches []Branch `json:"branches"`
	Fallback []Target `json:"fallback"`
}

type DiagnosticSpec struct {
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	Description string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	NativeCommand
}

type ExecutionStore interface {
	Detail(context.Context, string) (Detail, error)
	BeginTurn(context.Context, string, string) (Claim, error)
	BeginTurnOnBranch(context.Context, string, string, string) (Claim, error)
	BeginFallback(context.Context, string, Target) (Claim, error)
	Record(context.Context, string, engine.Event, bool) error
	FinishTurn(context.Context, string, engine.Outcome) error
}

type Handoff struct {
	ID             string         `json:"id"`
	SessionID      string         `json:"session_id"`
	SourceBranchID string         `json:"source_branch_id"`
	TargetBranchID string         `json:"target_branch_id"`
	Workspace      string         `json:"workspace"`
	Through        uint64         `json:"through"`
	Entries        []HandoffEntry `json:"entries"`
	Team           *TeamSnapshot  `json:"team,omitempty"`
	Processing     string         `json:"processing"`
}

type HandoffEntry struct {
	TurnID       string         `json:"turn_id"`
	Prompt       string         `json:"prompt"`
	Status       engine.Outcome `json:"status"`
	HistoryAfter uint64         `json:"history_after"`
	BranchID     string         `json:"branch_id"`
}

type HistoryEntry struct {
	Input     string         `json:"input,omitempty"`
	Sequence  uint64         `json:"sequence"`
	SessionID string         `json:"session_id"`
	TurnID    string         `json:"turn_id"`
	AttemptID string         `json:"attempt_id"`
	Event     engine.Event   `json:"event"`
	Time      int64          `json:"time"`
	Timeline  *TimelineEvent `json:"timeline,omitempty"`
}

type HookSpec struct {
	ID      string `json:"id"`
	Event   string `json:"event"`
	Matcher string `json:"matcher,omitempty"`
	NativeCommand
}

type MCPServer struct {
	ID                 string            `json:"id"`
	Command            string            `json:"command"`
	Args               []string          `json:"args,omitempty"`
	Env                map[string]string `json:"env,omitempty"`
	Enabled            bool              `json:"enabled"`
	HostAccessApproved bool              `json:"host_access_approved"`
}

type MediaDecoder struct {
	FFmpeg             string `json:"ffmpeg"`
	FFprobe            string `json:"ffprobe"`
	Enabled            bool   `json:"enabled"`
	HostAccessApproved bool   `json:"host_access_approved"`
}

type ModelConnection struct {
	ID          string            `json:"id"`
	Revision    uint64            `json:"revision"`
	Name        string            `json:"name"`
	Protocol    string            `json:"protocol"`
	Endpoint    string            `json:"endpoint"`
	Auth        string            `json:"auth"`
	Enabled     bool              `json:"enabled"`
	HasAPIKey   bool              `json:"has_api_key"`
	HeaderNames []string          `json:"header_names,omitempty"`
	Models      []ConnectionModel `json:"models"`
	CreatedAt   int64             `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt   int64             `json:"updated_at"`
}

type NativeCommand struct {
	Command            string            `json:"command"`
	Args               []string          `json:"args,omitempty"`
	Env                map[string]string `json:"env,omitempty"`
	TimeoutMS          int               `json:"timeout_ms,omitempty"`
	Enabled            bool              `json:"enabled"`
	HostAccessApproved bool              `json:"host_access_approved"`
}

type NativeOwnerResolver interface {
	NativeOwner(context.Context, string, string) (string, error)
}

type PreferenceOptions struct {
	Themes    []string
	Densities []string
	FontSizes []int
}

type PreferenceUpdate struct {
	ExpectedRevision uint64  `json:"expected_revision"`
	Theme            *string `json:"theme,omitempty"`
	Density          *string `json:"density,omitempty"`
	FontSize         *int    `json:"font_size,omitempty"`
}

type Preferences struct {
	Revision uint64 `json:"revision"`
	Theme    string `json:"theme"`
	Density  string `json:"density"`
	FontSize int    `json:"font_size"`
}

type PreferencesStore interface {
	Preferences(context.Context) (Preferences, error)
	UpdatePreferences(context.Context, PreferenceUpdate) (Preferences, error)
}

type ResourceClaim struct {
	Path  string `json:"path"`
	Write bool   `json:"write"`
}

type Runtime struct {
}

type Session struct {
	ID             string         `json:"id"`
	Title          string         `json:"title"`
	Workspace      string         `json:"workspace"`
	ActiveBranchID string         `json:"active_branch_id"`
	Status         engine.Outcome `json:"status"`
	CreatedAt      int64          `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt      int64          `json:"updated_at"`
}

type SessionCursor struct {
	Updated int64
	ID      string
}

type SessionPage struct {
	Sessions []Session
	Next     SessionCursor
	HasMore  bool
}

type SessionStore interface {
	CreateSession(context.Context, string, string, Target) (Session, error)
	ListSessions(context.Context, int) ([]Session, error)
	PageSessions(context.Context, string, SessionCursor, int) (SessionPage, error)
	Switch(context.Context, string, Target, string) (Branch, error)
	SetFallback(context.Context, string, []Target) error
	History(context.Context, string, uint64, int) ([]HistoryEntry, error)
	HistoryBefore(context.Context, string, uint64, int) ([]HistoryEntry, error)
	ReadHandoff(context.Context, string, string) (*Handoff, error)
	BindNative(context.Context, string, string, string) error
	Recover(context.Context) error
}

type Settings struct {
	DurableWaits      bool            `json:"durable_waits"`
	PlanMode          bool            `json:"plan_mode,omitempty"`
	Version           int             `json:"version"`
	SessionID         string          `json:"session_id"`
	MCP               []MCPServer     `json:"mcp"`
	AEP               []AEPBundle     `json:"aep,omitempty"`
	SkillsEnabled     bool            `json:"skills_enabled"`
	SubagentsEnabled  bool            `json:"subagents_enabled"`
	PersistentMemory  bool            `json:"persistent_memory"`
	MediaEnabled      bool            `json:"media_enabled"`
	MediaDecoder      MediaDecoder    `json:"media_decoder"`
	Browser           BrowserSettings `json:"browser"`
	Commands          CommandSettings `json:"commands"`
	Tools             ToolSettings    `json:"tools"`
	SkillArchives     []string        `json:"skill_archives,omitempty"`
	CompatibilityFile string          `json:"compatibility_file,omitempty"`
}

type SettingsStore interface {
	Settings(context.Context, string) (Settings, error)
	SaveSettings(context.Context, Settings) error
	SetPlanMode(context.Context, string, bool) error
	ReplaceMCP(context.Context, string, []MCPServer) error
	SetMCPEnabled(context.Context, string, string, bool, bool) error
	SetSkillsEnabled(context.Context, string, bool) error
	SetCompatibilityFile(context.Context, string, string) error
	SetSubagentsEnabled(context.Context, string, bool) error
	SetPersistentMemory(context.Context, string, bool) error
	SetMediaEnabled(context.Context, string, bool) error
	ReplaceMediaDecoder(context.Context, string, MediaDecoder) error
	SetMediaDecoderEnabled(context.Context, string, bool, bool) error
	ReplaceBrowser(context.Context, string, BrowserSettings) error
	SetBrowserEnabled(context.Context, string, bool, bool) error
	ReplaceCommands(context.Context, string, CommandSettings) error
	SetCommandEnabled(context.Context, string, string, string, bool, bool) error
	ReplaceAEP(context.Context, string, []AEPBundle) error
	SetAEPEnabled(context.Context, string, string, bool, bool) error
	RecordSkillArchive(context.Context, string, string) error
}

type ShellSettings struct {
	Executable         string            `json:"executable"`
	Env                map[string]string `json:"env,omitempty"`
	Enabled            bool              `json:"enabled"`
	HostAccessApproved bool              `json:"host_access_approved"`
}

type Store interface {
	ExecutionStore
	SessionStore
	SettingsStore
}

type Target struct {
	EngineID             string   `json:"engine_id"`
	ModelID              string   `json:"model_id"`
	ProviderID           string   `json:"provider_id"`
	AccountSource        string   `json:"account_source"`
	BillingRoute         string   `json:"billing_route"`
	AutomaticAuthorized  bool     `json:"automatic_authorized"`
	RequiredCapabilities []string `json:"required_capabilities,omitempty"`
}

type TeamDetail struct {
	Team    TeamRun  `json:"team"`
	Workers []Worker `json:"workers"`
}

type TeamRun struct {
	ID            string `json:"id"`
	LeadSessionID string `json:"lead_session_id"`
	Status        string `json:"status"`
	CreatedAt     int64  `json:"created_at"`
}

type TeamSnapshot struct {
	Role          string               `json:"role"`
	TeamID        string               `json:"team_id"`
	LeadSessionID string               `json:"lead_session_id"`
	Status        string               `json:"status"`
	CapturedAt    int64                `json:"captured_at"`
	Workers       []TeamWorkerSnapshot `json:"workers"`
	Processing    string               `json:"processing"`
}

type TeamStore interface {
	CreateTeam(context.Context, string) (TeamDetail, error)
	Team(context.Context, string, string) (TeamDetail, error)
	TeamForLead(context.Context, string) (TeamDetail, error)
	AddWorker(context.Context, string, string, string, Target) (Worker, error)
	SetWorkerLifecycle(context.Context, string, string, string, WorkerLifecycle) error
	EndTeam(context.Context, string, string) error
	EnqueueWorker(context.Context, string, string, string, string, []ResourceClaim) (WorkerTask, error)
	EditQueuedTask(context.Context, string, string, string, string, string, []ResourceClaim) error
	CancelQueuedTask(context.Context, string, string, string, string) error
	WorkerTasks(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, int) (WorkerTaskPage, error)
	ClaimWorkerTask(context.Context, string, string, string) (WorkerClaim, error)
}

type TeamTaskIndex struct {
	TaskID           string         `json:"task_id"`
	Sequence         uint64         `json:"sequence"`
	Status           engine.Outcome `json:"status"`
	TurnID           string         `json:"turn_id,omitempty"`
	ResultSequence   uint64         `json:"result_sequence,omitempty"`
	RequiredBranchID string         `json:"required_branch_id,omitempty"`
}

type TeamWorkerSnapshot struct {
	WorkerID    string          `json:"worker_id"`
	SessionID   string          `json:"session_id"`
	Lifecycle   WorkerLifecycle `json:"lifecycle"`
	BranchID    string          `json:"branch_id"`
	EngineID    string          `json:"engine_id"`
	Status      engine.Outcome  `json:"status"`
	Queued      int             `json:"queued"`
	Running     int             `json:"running"`
	Head        *TeamTaskIndex  `json:"head,omitempty"`
	LastOutcome *TeamTaskIndex  `json:"last_outcome,omitempty"`
}

type TimelineEvent struct {
	Kind         string  `json:"kind"`
	Text         string  `json:"text"`
	FromBranchID string  `json:"from_branch_id,omitempty"`
	ToBranchID   string  `json:"to_branch_id,omitempty"`
	HandoffID    string  `json:"handoff_id,omitempty"`
	Target       *Target `json:"target,omitempty"`
}

type ToolSettings struct {
	Planning    bool          `json:"planning"`
	Notebook    bool          `json:"notebook"`
	Interaction bool          `json:"interaction"`
	Utility     bool          `json:"utility"`
	Shell       ShellSettings `json:"shell"`
	Web         WebSettings   `json:"web"`
}

type ToolSettingsStore interface {
	ReplaceTools(context.Context, string, ToolSettings) error
	SetToolEnabled(context.Context, string, string, bool, bool) error
}

type Turn struct {
	ID              string         `json:"id"`
	AutomationID    string         `json:"automation_id,omitempty"`
	SessionID       string         `json:"session_id"`
	Sequence        uint64         `json:"sequence"`
	Prompt          string         `json:"prompt"`
	Status          engine.Outcome `json:"status"`
	ActiveAttemptID string         `json:"active_attempt_id"`
	CreatedAt       int64          `json:"created_at"`
	EndedAt         int64          `json:"ended_at"`
}

type WaitStore interface {
	SetDurableWaits(context.Context, string, bool) error
	BranchTurn(context.Context, string, string) (Turn, error)
	BeginWaitResume(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64) (Claim, error)
	AbandonWaitingTurn(context.Context, string, string, string) error
}

type WebSettings struct {
	Enabled               bool     `json:"enabled"`
	NetworkAccessApproved bool     `json:"network_access_approved"`
	ReadURLs              bool     `json:"read_urls"`
	SearchEndpoint        string   `json:"search_endpoint,omitempty"`
	AllowedPrivateOrigins []string `json:"allowed_private_origins,omitempty"`
	TimeoutMS             int      `json:"timeout_ms,omitempty"`
}

type Worker struct {
	ID        string          `json:"id"`
	TeamID    string          `json:"team_id"`
	SessionID string          `json:"session_id"`
	Name      string          `json:"name"`
	Lifecycle WorkerLifecycle `json:"lifecycle"`
	CreatedAt int64           `json:"created_at"`
	Worktree  *WorkerWorktree `json:"worktree,omitempty"`
}

type WorkerClaim struct {
	Task      WorkerTask
	Claim     *Claim
	BlockedBy []string
	Dormant   bool
}

type WorkerDraftStore interface {
	EnqueueWorkerOnBranch(context.Context, string, string, string, string, string, []ResourceClaim) (WorkerTask, error)
}

type WorkerLifecycle string

type WorkerOutcome struct {
	Status         engine.Outcome `json:"status"`
	TurnID         string         `json:"turn_id"`
	Summary        string         `json:"summary"`
	ResultSequence uint64         `json:"result_sequence,omitempty"`
	ChangedFiles   []string       `json:"changed_files"`
	Verification   []string       `json:"verification"`
	Risks          []string       `json:"risks"`
	Processing     string         `json:"processing"`
}

type WorkerTask struct {
	ID               string          `json:"id"`
	Sequence         uint64          `json:"sequence"`
	TeamID           string          `json:"team_id"`
	WorkerID         string          `json:"worker_id"`
	Scope            string          `json:"scope"`
	Claims           []ResourceClaim `json:"claims"`
	Status           engine.Outcome  `json:"status"`
	TurnID           string          `json:"turn_id"`
	Outcome          *WorkerOutcome  `json:"outcome,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        int64           `json:"created_at"`
	EndedAt          int64           `json:"ended_at"`
	RequiredBranchID string          `json:"required_branch_id,omitempty"`
}

type WorkerTaskPage struct {
	Tasks   []WorkerTask `json:"tasks"`
	Next    uint64       `json:"next"`
	HasMore bool         `json:"has_more"`
}

type WorkerWorktree struct {
	State    string                 `json:"state"`
	Binding  WorktreeBinding        `json:"binding"`
	Evidence *WorktreeEvidence      `json:"evidence,omitempty"`
	Adoption string                 `json:"adoption,omitempty"`
	Problem  string                 `json:"problem,omitempty"`
	Revision uint64                 `json:"revision"`
	Removal  *WorktreeRemovalReview `json:"removal,omitempty"`
}

type WorktreeBinding struct {
	Version    int    `json:"version"`
	WorkerID   string `json:"worker_id"`
	Workspace  string `json:"shared_workspace"`
	Path       string `json:"path"`
	Branch     string `json:"branch"`
	BaseCommit string `json:"base_commit"`
}

type WorktreeChange struct {
	Path         string `json:"path"`
	BeforeSHA256 string `json:"before_sha256,omitempty"`
	AfterSHA256  string `json:"after_sha256,omitempty"`
	BeforeMode   string `json:"before_mode,omitempty"`
	AfterMode    string `json:"after_mode,omitempty"`
}

type WorktreeEvidence struct {
	ID            string           `json:"id"`
	WorkerID      string           `json:"worker_id"`
	BaseCommit    string           `json:"base_commit"`
	WorkerSHA256  string           `json:"worker_sha256"`
	SharedSHA256  string           `json:"shared_sha256"`
	PatchSHA256   string           `json:"patch_sha256"`
	PatchBytes    int              `json:"patch_bytes"`
	SnapshotBytes int              `json:"snapshot_bytes"`
	CreatedAt     int64            `json:"created_at"`
	Changes       []WorktreeChange `json:"changes"`
}

type WorktreeRemovalReview struct {
	WorkerSHA256 string `json:"worker_sha256"`
	IndexSHA256  string `json:"index_sha256"`
	Head         string `json:"head"`
	Files        int    `json:"files"`
	Bytes        int    `json:"bytes"`
	CreatedAt    int64  `json:"created_at"`
}

type WorktreeStore interface {
	BeginWorkerWorktree(context.Context, string, string, string) (Worker, error)
	FinishWorkerWorktree(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, WorktreeBinding, string) (Worker, error)
	SaveWorkerEvidence(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, WorktreeEvidence) (Worker, error)
	BeginWorkerAdoption(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, string) (Worker, error)
	FinishWorkerAdoption(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, string) (Worker, error)
	SaveWorkerRemovalReview(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, WorktreeRemovalReview) (Worker, error)
	BeginWorkerRemoval(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, string) (Worker, error)
	FinishWorkerRemoval(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, bool) (Worker, error)
}

var ErrAutomationRouteChanged = errors.New("automation paused because its route or collaboration scope changed")

var ErrAutomationSkipped = errors.New("automation tick skipped; no catch-up or queued execution")

var ErrAutomationStale = errors.New("automation changed, paused, claimed or not due; refresh before acting")

var ErrConnectionConflict = errors.New("model connection changed; reload before saving")

var ErrInvalidPreferences = errors.New("invalid application preferences")

var ErrNotFound = errors.New("product object is unavailable in this scope")

var ErrPreferenceConflict = errors.New("preferences changed; reload before saving")

var ErrSessionBusy = errors.New("Hub session already running")

var ErrSessionNotRunning = errors.New("Hub session is not running")

var ErrWorkerDormant = errors.New("Worker is dormant or Team has ended")

var ErrWorkerQueueEmpty = errors.New("Worker queue is empty")

var ErrWorkerResourcesBlocked = errors.New("Worker head is waiting for older or running resource claims")
